About.title: COMPANY PROFILE
About.paragraph1: Based on Notarial Deed No. 75 dated June 24, 2021, and the Decision of the Minister of Law and Human Rights of the Republic of Indonesia No. AHU-0002735.AH.01.01 of 2021 regarding the appointment of Mr. Ir. RIADI as Head of the Infrastructure Division of PT Modern Widya Tehnical.
About.paragraph2: PT Modern Widya Tehnical is a national construction services company established in 1979, with over 40 years of experience handling various Building, Industrial, Infrastructure, and Utility Projects throughout Indonesia. Supported by international standards and professional teams, we are committed to being a RELIABLE and TRUSTWORTHY partner.
About.paragraph3: Entering more than 40 years of service, we have handled various areas of construction services, including the construction of buildings, commercial areas, housing, industrial facilities, road and bridge infrastructure, water works, ports, power plants, to design and build projects. Our works are spread across almost all regions of Indonesia, from Sumatra to Papua.

VisiMisi.title: VISION & MISSION
VisiMisi.subtitle: Our Strategic Direction and Commitment
VisiMisi.visionText: To be a reliable and trustworthy construction company in completing construction projects on time, with the right quality, within budget, with orderly administration, and safely, supported by professional and reliable human resources.
missions: Completing projects in accordance with the schedule specified by the project owner.
Completing projects in accordance with the project owner's specifications.
Ensuring that the use of buildings and/or infrastructure is safe for facility users.
Carrying out construction according to the established budget, with costs fully accountable to the Company's Board of Directors.
Continuously improving the quality of human resources through training to enhance professionalism.
